title: Design Metrics & Monitoring System (Prometheus / Datadog)
subtitle: High-throughput time-series metrics collection, TSDB sharding, downsampling, and alerting

stages.title: Stage 1 — Push-Based Logs & Cron Aggregation
stages.bottleneck: App servers sending logs over HTTP blocks request execution. Log parsing script takes hours on large logs.
stages.narrative:
**Log-based Monitoring MVP.** Application servers push log lines to a log server, which parses CPU and error rates into MySQL.

**Bottleneck:** High disk I/O cost and missing real-time visibility into production outages.

stages.title: Stage 2 — Pull-Based Metrics Scraper & Time-Series DB (Prometheus)
stages.bottleneck: Storing millions of metric data points (`cpu_usage`, `http_requests_total`) in relational DB causes table bloat.
stages.narrative: **Pull Architecture & TSDB Storage.** Prometheus scrapes metrics endpoints every 15 seconds. Data is compressed using **Gorilla XOR Floating-Point Encoding** (reducing 16-byte float data points down to 1.37 bytes).

stages.title: Stage 3 — Distributed Kafka Ingestion & TSDB Sharding
stages.bottleneck: A single Prometheus server runs out of disk space and CPU when monitoring 10,000+ microservice instances.
stages.narrative: **Horizontal TSDB Sharding.** Metric streams are ingested into Kafka and sharded across multiple TSDB nodes by metric name + label hashes. This allows scaling metrics ingestion to millions of data points per second.

stages.title: Stage 4 — Real-Time Alerting, Grafana Dashboards & Downsampling
stages.bottleneck: Querying 1 year of raw 15-second metric data points crashes browser dashboards due to payload size.
stages.narrative:
**Downsampling & Alertmanager.**
1. **Downsampling:** Raw 15s data points are rolled up into 1-minute averages after 7 days, and 1-hour averages after 30 days.
2. **Alerting:** Alertmanager evaluates PromQL rules (`cpu_usage > 90% for 5m`) and triggers PagerDuty / Slack notifications.
